OWNER_AND_SCALAR_FENCES_REMOVED.assertion: Returned subscription IDs are exactly the current pharmacy candidate subset; actual foreign canonical ID is forbidden.
OWNER_AND_SCALAR_FENCES_REMOVED.counterexample: Two operational pharmacies with interleaved valid due rows; own token/first page. Record actual foreign ID in HTTP response privately.

QUERY_ROW_BOUND_REMOVED.assertion: The completed actual DB read returns at most limit+1; a subsequent503 is not proof the query was bounded.
QUERY_ROW_BOUND_REMOVED.counterexample: Owned fixture80 valid due rows, limit50. Record completed native/model result count before row guard; variant must read>51, not merely throw.

RAW_QUERY_ALLOWLIST_WEAKENED.assertion: Extra owner key returns400 before repository dispatch; accepted ignored field with a real DB query is forbidden.
RAW_QUERY_ALLOWLIST_WEAKENED.counterexample: Valid own request plus foreign pharmacyId query. Nominal400/no dispatch; variant accepts and returns200 own data, exposing validation loss, not a foreign-scope claim.

PATIENT_FIELD_LEAKED.assertion: Closed HTTP DTO keys exclude patient identity; actual synthetic userId in response is forbidden.
PATIENT_FIELD_LEAKED.counterexample: Owned valid subscription has actual userId; independently compare received field to seeded fixture user ID, not only schema/hash.

UNDEFINED_RESUME_RESTORED.assertion: Explicit resume really removes pausedUntil from persisted BSON and returned row; retained old pause is forbidden.
UNDEFINED_RESUME_RESTORED.counterexample: Seed paused false/future date, resume through real service+Mongoose then fresh native read; nominal missing field, variant retains it.

SYMBOL_GETTER_GUARD_REGRESSED.assertion: Descriptor-safe raw reply validation fails closed before supplied code/partial output.
SYMBOL_GETTER_GUARD_REGRESSED.counterexample: A native Symbol getter is ACTUALLY invoked (>0) on hostile actual-source reply even if a later safe503 occurs; arbitrary exception alone is not detection.

DENSE_ARRAY_GUARD_REGRESSED.assertion: Descriptor-safe raw reply validation fails closed before supplied code/partial output.
DENSE_ARRAY_GUARD_REGRESSED.counterexample: Sparse returned array yields actual HTTP200 items containing null, or supplied map is ACTUALLY invoked; nominal503/no method call uses same source assertion.
